events.description: A multi-person physical altercation erupts under the basket involving players from both teams (Wizards in red, Warriors in white), coaches, and staff, with pushing, grabbing, and shoving escalating into a large scrum near the sideline and scorer's table.

During the melee, a player in a red jersey (No. 2) appears to strike or forcefully push a fallen or seated individual (likely a staff member or spectator) near the baseline, while others are engaged in the fight around him.

A multi-person physical altercation erupts near the baseline involving players from both teams (including #2 Porter, #12 Wall, #9 Iguodala, #35 Durant) and several non-players (coaches, staff, security). The fight escalates rapidly with pushing, shoving, grabbing, and at least one player being thrown to the ground (visible in f1–f3), followed by a dense scrum where multiple individuals are engaged in mutual combat (f4–f13). The conflict persists through f15 with active grappling and attempts to separate participants.

Multiple players from opposing teams (Warriors in white, Wizards in red) are engaged in a physical altercation near the sideline, with pushing, grabbing, and attempts to separate them by officials and staff. Visible contact includes Durant (35) and Porter (22) in close confrontation, with others joining the scuffle.

The initial fight escalates into a larger chaotic group confrontation involving players, coaches, security personnel, and spectators near the courtside area. The crowd is highly agitated, some individuals are standing on seats, and multiple people are physically intervening or being restrained. The scene shows collective violent unrest beyond a simple two-person fight.

A physical altercation occurs between Washington Wizards players (notably #13 Gortat and #22 Porter) and Golden State Warriors player #30 Stephen Curry near the sideline, involving pushing, grabbing, and close confrontation, with officials and teammates intervening to separate them.
Multiple players and staff engage in a physical altercation near the basket after a play, involving shoving, grabbing, and attempts to separate individuals; referees and coaches intervene.
A player in white (No. 11) appears to strike or push a fallen opponent in red while the latter is on the ground near the baseline, with others intervening.
